The first lot and destruction order say fourteenth Adar, while the counter-order and initial action say thirteenth; these differences are not reconciled.
The opening gifts and later statement of no reward remain an unresolved chronology candidate, with zero credit for that proposed equation.
The Haman in the eunuch list is not equated with Haman son of Hammedatha from the shared name alone.

The corrected third-day wording does not imply three days elapsed after prayer; the approach occurs on the third day when prayer has ceased.
Opening and later eunuch reports are compared by their supplied statements without harmonizing every identity, document or reward detail.
The two royal letters' claims about peace, fairness and Haman's character remain attributed claims, not narrator-endorsed moral assessments.
